widgets_values: A science fiction scene set in a fossil megafauna ridge. A hastily repaired dreadnought-class starship is touching down hard in a spray of loose rock. It has a spindle hull, clad in umber bioorganic hull plate. It features a fuel scoop. It bears four emerald-green radiator seams. Past it, a field of light-drinking crystal fronds catches the light. Rendered as terrarium miniature garden in a glass vessel where layered soil and moss and small plant build a living diorama, condensation droplet on the inner glass surface, humid enclosed ecosystem under greenhouse lighting through the glass, a miniature landscape composition contained within the transparent vessel.

widgets_values:
Drag to connect Sci-Fi, Fantasy, or Horror prompt_text into the Stylebook user prompt on the right.

If you want to mix genres, drag any "entity" ouptut into a scene's entity input (example: horror to fantasy). Expreiement!

Repo for more info: https://github.com/EnragedAntelope/comfyui-sceneweaver
